# Blueprint: Elementor Adapter Plugin

Copy `designbook-wordpress/sync/templates/elementor/` into `plugins/<ns>-elementor/`. Substitute
`__NAMESPACE__` with the theme slug in the plugin main file. Src and assets files copy unchanged.

`plugin.<ns>_elementor` — `plugins/<ns>-elementor/<ns>-elementor.php`, from `plugin.php`:

```php
<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: <ns> Elementor
 * Description: Elementor adapter generated by Designbook.
 */
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) {
    exit;
}

add_action('elementor/init', static function (): void {
    require_once __DIR__ . '/src/Controls.php';
    require_once __DIR__ . '/src/Document.php';
    require_once __DIR__ . '/src/LeafWidget.php';
    require_once __DIR__ . '/src/NestedWidget.php';
    require_once __DIR__ . '/src/Plugin.php';
    require_once __DIR__ . '/src/Seed.php';
    require_once __DIR__ . '/src/Tokens.php';

    \Designbook\Elementor\Plugin::boot('<ns>', __DIR__);
});
```

`plugin.<ns>_elementor.src.<stem>` — one unit per copied file (`<stem>` lowercase):

| Stem | Path |
|---|---|
| `controls` | `src/Controls.php` |
| `document` | `src/Document.php` |
| `leaf_widget` | `src/LeafWidget.php` |
| `nested_widget` | `src/NestedWidget.php` |
| `plugin` | `src/Plugin.php` |
| `seed` | `src/Seed.php` |
| `tokens` | `src/Tokens.php` |
| `editor` | `assets/editor.js` |

`template.<ns>.elementor_page` — `page-template.php` copied to `themes/<ns>/elementor-designbook.php`.
The template prints `wp_head`, the designbook header part, `the_content()`, the footer part, and
`wp_footer`.
